4. **DevOps, Infrastructure & Tooling**:

## 3. Notable Software Engineering Projects
### 3.1 AdZero (Android Application - v4.4)
- **Category**: Mobile Application / Ad-Blocking Utility / Media Streaming
- **Role**: Creator, Lead Architect & Developer (Mohd Kaif)
- **Target OS**: Android (Material Design 3)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/kaif-webwork/AdZero
- **Detailed Overview**: AdZero eliminates video ad interruptions, tracking telemetry, and intrusive popups. Built natively with Kotlin and modern Android SDK primitives, it incorporates custom video player controls, smart categories, and low-latency buffer management.

### 3.2 kaifcoder.in Real-Time Analytics System
- **Category**: Full Stack Web Platform / Distributed Analytics
- **Role**: Creator & Maintainer
- **Live URL**: https://www.kaifcoder.in/analytics
- **Key Features**: Privacy-preserving edge visit logging, zero-cookie deduplication per hardware client, 0ms tab switching between 24h/7d/30d series, interactive ECharts telemetry, sub-600ms cold builds.
